result_text:
The per-extension entries are now named by the bare lower-cased extension (`"java"`, `"js"`, `"xml"`), and the landscape merges old and new spellings under one entry. The full `codeanalyzer` suite passes offline: 330 tests, 0 failures, 3 skipped.

Changes, all in `codeanalyzer/src/main`:

- **`aspects/SourceCodeAspectUtils.java`**: `getAspectsPerExtensions` creates each per-extension aspect as `extension` instead of `"  *." + extension`. This name also flows into `analysisResults.json` and `getScopesWithExtensions`.
- **`analysis/AnalysisUtils.java`**: dropped the `.replace("*.", "")` on the extension name when building the `_EXT_` metric ids. The ids are unchanged (`NUMBER_OF_FILES_MAIN_EXT_JAVA`, and so on).
- **`landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`**: added a private `getBareExtension` helper that turns `"  *.java"` and `"java"` into `"java"`. It is used for the per-repository aggregation key and in `merge(...)`, which combines the build, generated and other scopes. Each repository still adds its own description entry to a merged extension.

Tests updated to the bare names: `CodeConfigurationTest` and `NamedSourceCodeAspectTest`.

I did not touch the report modules. They still call `.replace("*.", "")` on extension names. Those calls are now no-ops for fresh analyses and still handle decorated names from older data. I left them alone because the task scoped the change to the five listed files.
